# Purpose
The provided content is a GitHub Actions workflow configuration file, written in YAML, designed to automate the process of checking Android compatibility for a codebase. This workflow is triggered by push events, excluding those from Dependabot branches, and pull requests. It sets up a job named `check-android-compatibility` that runs on the latest Ubuntu environment. The workflow includes steps to check out the code, set up Java Development Kit (JDK) version 11 using the Temurin distribution, and execute a Maven command to check Android compatibility while skipping tests and excluding the `test-jpms` module. This setup ensures that the codebase maintains compatibility with Android environments without redundant workflow executions.
